rationale: IT consultants and sysadmins regularly encounter the Apache + Entra ID SSO configuration problem as a billable-hours drain, with the 929-line sample config serving as concrete evidence of friction. The buyer is clearly in a paid professional context (Microsoft Entra ID licenses start ~$6/user/month, consultant billing $100–200/hr), and the ServerFault thread plus broad Stack Overflow/Reddit/community signal confirms this is a recurring pain across the global sysadmin population. At least one willingness-to-pay signal exists: the consultant is already billing a client for this work, and competitors like JumpCloud and Okta charge $3–15/user/month for managed SSO solutions.
